explication: Claude Code Action turns GitHub issue, PR, comment, or automation events into an authenticated Claude run, with GitHub context and repository tools available to the agent. The main path validates the event and permissions, selects a mode, gathers GitHub data and prepares a prompt, configures a branch and integrations where applicable, then runs Claude and reports results. README features such as review, implementation, progress reporting, and structured outputs are represented where the tree or excerpts support them; wiring to unsampled subsystems is left out.
